name: sgs/buybox
title: Buybox
description: WooCommerce single-product PDP area: renders the full product hero (gallery column + configurator column) as a responsive 2-column CSS Grid. Gallery column shows the variation-aware image gallery (main image + thumbnail strip, driven by the sgs/product-card Interactivity store). Configurator column renders per-axis option-picker pills, live price row, comparative value ladder, stock status, back-in-stock notify form, and an accessible add-to-cart form. Falls back to core WC blocks for simple products or when WooCommerce is absent.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: Two independently-scoped media elements: 'main' is the gallery-col.php .product-card__media .product-card-img (the large PDP display image); 'thumb' is the .product-card__thumb img thumbnail-rail image (a distinct role — a small selectable preview, not the same image rendered twice). Mirrors sgs/before-after's before/after prefix pattern so a client can set a different fit for each.

wrapper.label: Buybox wrapper
wrapper._note: supports.color is explicitly {background:false,text:false} and spacing.padding is false — this thin composer block carries no paint/typography surface of its own (it composes sgs/product-card + sgs/option-picker, which own their own styling). layout is scoped to margin only; every other layout member is an honest gap.

fx._comment_providesNatively: Spec 38 FR-38-13. This block's horizontal scroller is `.product-card__thumbs`, a DESCENDANT, while the generic 'Scroll & effects' picker stamps data-sgs-fx onto the block ROOT — so a picker entry here would be a control that silently does nothing. The CSS-derived `track` provision (2026-07-31) correctly sees the scroller and would otherwise offer it. Declared here to suppress that entry. Own drag toggle SHIPPED 2026-07-31 (register Step 3): `dragToScroll`/`dragMomentum` attrs below, mirroring sgs/gallery + sgs/post-grid + sgs/google-reviews. Proven on a product-page fixture (product 541/540 variation gallery expanded to 10 images so the 64px-thumb strip genuinely overflows its ~644px column at 1440px) BEFORE this attr existed: scrollWidth 712 > clientWidth 644, confirming the scroller is real. The toggle itself ships unverified live in THIS session — it needs a build + deploy this session did not run (constrained to no-deploy) — so re-run the same fixture after deploy and confirm cursor:grab + data-sgs-fx="draggable" appear before treating the capability as proven end-to-end.

soldOutLabel.description: Aria-label suffix appended to pill labels when a combination is sold out. Shown to screen readers only.

unavailableLabel.description: Aria-label suffix appended to pill labels when a combination does not exist for the current selections.

notifyEnabled.description: Show the 'notify me when back in stock' email-capture form on out-of-stock variations.

notifyMeLabel.description: Heading/label for the back-in-stock notify-me form.

addToCartLabel.description: Override the Add to Cart button label. Empty = use the default translated string.

perUnitDenomination.description: Override the per-unit denomination template. Use %s as the placeholder for the unit label (e.g. 'per bar', 'per 100g'). Empty = translated default 'per %s'.

showLadder.description: Show the comparative value-ladder table. Set false to suppress it (e.g. in narrow sidebar contexts).

framingMode.description: Saving-label framing: 'savings' (positive), 'loss-aversion' (adds 'vs buying singly' tail), or 'neutral' (no saving label).

decoyEnabled.description: When true, the 'Best value' badge targets the 2nd-largest pack (decoy effect) instead of the largest.

dragToScroll.description: Lets desktop shoppers click and drag the thumbnail strip, on top of its native scroll/swipe. Spec 38 FR-38-13.

dragMomentum.description: When drag-to-scroll is on, keep coasting briefly after release like a real scroll flick.

loopCarousel.description: Scrolling or dragging the thumbnail strip past the last image continues into the first, and back again — never a dead end. Independent of drag-to-scroll; combinable or standalone. Spec 38 §11 loop FR.

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
